name: @retroplug/mesen
description: The Mesen core's half of the app: the mesen core-config role every Mesen system carries (NES, GBA, SMS/GG) - region, sprite limit, FM, APU latency, the cartridge-accuracy switches, expansion volume, the per-channel export mode, the emulated N8's SD root, FIFO profile and reliable link, and driving a real cart - and the settings enums its schema reads. Its native half (rp_mesen_package) is still packages/native's until F2.
